newsitem.title: ARMENIA: Armenian high court sentences party activists to death.
newsitem.headline: Armenian high court sentences party activists to death.

text.p: Armenia's Supreme Court on Tuesday sentenced three members of the outlawed Dashnaktsitun political party to death on terrorism charges.
Judge Eduard Manukyan said Armen Mndjoyan, Arsen Arsrune and Armen Grigoryan would be put to death for terrorist activities, drugs trafficking, and arms dealing.
Lawyers for the condemned immediately said they planned to appeal. Eight other members of the nationalist party got sentences of three to 15 years in prison.
Dashnaktsitun was outlawed in 1994 by President Levon Ter-Petrosyan who said its members were plotting terrorist acts and wanted to overthrow the government.
But Dashnaktsitun maintained it was the victim of a witchunt to crack down on dissent in the small Caucasus state of three and a half million.

Ter-Petrosyan closed several opposition parties earlier this year and sent tanks into the streets after he won a controversial second term in office. International observers said the vote was marred by major violations.
